_note: Openly licensed public floor plans for the DXF importer. Each entry is pinned to a commit and a SHA-256. The licence was read from the repository's own licence file at that commit and is recorded here. Files are fetched into plans/corpora/dxf-floor-plans (gitignored) and are never committed or redistributed by Lolly, which matters for the ShareAlike file. Ordinary tests need none of them.
